dialogues.jp: 「お？　あれって、暦先生か？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Isn't that Koyomi-sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Isn't that Koyomi-sensei?"

dialogues.jp: スーパーに夕飯を買いに行った帰りのこと。
dialogues.en:
I was on my way back home from grabbing dinner at the
supermarket.
dialogues.text:
I was on my way back home from grabbing dinner at the
supermarket.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、何かの建物の前に｛たたず／佇｝む暦先生を発見した。
dialogues.en:
I found Koyomi-sensei waiting around some nondescript
building.
dialogues.text:
I found Koyomi-sensei waiting around some nondescript
building.

dialogues.jp:
「隣に男の人が居るけど……あれが、婚約者な
　のかな？　……ちょっと、顔でも拝んでみる
　か」
dialogues.en:
"There's a guy next to her... is that her fiance? ...I'm
kinda interested in what he looks like..."
dialogues.text:
"There's a guy next to her... is that her fiance? ...I'm
kinda interested in what he looks like..."

dialogues.jp: 「どうも〜。こんばんは」
dialogues.en: "Hey there~ Good evening."
dialogues.text: "Hey there~ Good evening."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「う。朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Man
dialogues.jp: 「知り合い？」
dialogues.en: "You know him?"
dialogues.text: "You know him?"

dialogues.jp:
セーターにチノパンという姿の男性が、暦先生
に柔らかく問いかける。
dialogues.en:
The man wore a turtleneck sweater. His query to
Koyomi-sensei was gentle.
dialogues.text:
The man wore a turtleneck sweater. His query to
Koyomi-sensei was gentle.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん、あたしが春まで受け持っていたク
　ラスの学生」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, yes, I was his form teacher for the classes last
spring."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, yes, I was his form teacher for the classes last
spring."

dialogues.jp:
どーもどーもと男性に会釈する。男性は、人の
良さそうな笑顔を浮かべた。
dialogues.en:
The man gave an understanding nod, and smiled good-naturedly
at me.
dialogues.text:
The man gave an understanding nod, and smiled good-naturedly
at me.

dialogues.jp:
（なるほど。ことりの言った通り、感じのいい
　人だな）
dialogues.en: "(I see. Kotori was right, he seems like a good man.)"
dialogues.text: "(I see. Kotori was right, he seems like a good man.)"

dialogues.jp:
一方の暦先生は、明らかにばつの悪そうな顔。
悪戯の現場を押さえられた、とでもいうような。
これはやっぱり……。
dialogues.en:
On the other hand, Koyomi-sensei was definitely
uncomfortable with the situation. She's afraid of my
teasing... or perhaps...
dialogues.text:
On the other hand, Koyomi-sensei was definitely
uncomfortable with the situation. She's afraid of my
teasing... or perhaps...

dialogues.jp: 「新居探しですか？　先生」
dialogues.en: "Are you looking at new homes, sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking at new homes, sensei?"

dialogues.jp:
ふたりが向いていた先──不動産屋の張り紙に
目を向けながら、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
The two of them were facing a poster advertising the
building as real estate, so I made an educated guess.
dialogues.text:
The two of them were facing a poster advertising the
building as real estate, so I made an educated guess.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「い？　き、君は何を言ってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? W, what are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? W, what are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ことりから聞いたんですよ。今度先生が結婚
　するって」
dialogues.en:
"I'm heard from Kotori already. That you're getting
married."
dialogues.text:
"I'm heard from Kotori already. That you're getting
married."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「う……もう、あの子ったら、口が軽いんだか
　ら……」
dialogues.en: "Ugh... geez, that girl has way too big a mouth..."
dialogues.text: "Ugh... geez, that girl has way too big a mouth..."

dialogues.speaker: Man
dialogues.jp:
「あれ。何だ、暦さん、学園の人達には、まだ
　伝えてなかったの？」
dialogues.en: "Huh. You haven't told the school about this yet, Koyomi?"
dialogues.text: "Huh. You haven't told the school about this yet, Koyomi?"

dialogues.jp:
ふと、男性の手に目が行った。左手の薬指に、
エンゲージリングがある。
dialogues.en:
His eyes travelled to his hand. On his left hand's ring
finger was an engagement ring.
dialogues.text:
His eyes travelled to his hand. On his left hand's ring
finger was an engagement ring.

dialogues.jp:
そして、暦先生の同じ場所にも──普段、学園
ではしていないのに──指輪がはまっていた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi had one in the same place as well--although I've
never seen it during school.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi had one in the same place as well--although I've
never seen it during school.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「え？　う、うん、だって、冷やかされたりす
　るの、嫌だったしさ。別に、わざわざ言う必
　要もないかなって」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? N, no, I just didn't want it to be a big issue. There's
no need for so much fuss about it."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? N, no, I just didn't want it to be a big issue. There's
no need for so much fuss about it."

dialogues.jp:
婚約者に対する時の暦先生は、いつもよりちょっ
とだけ、女っぽさを感じた。
dialogues.en:
While talking with her fiance, for the first time, I felt
that Koyomi-sensei was actually behaving like a girl.
dialogues.text:
While talking with her fiance, for the first time, I felt
that Koyomi-sensei was actually behaving like a girl.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、ま、俺は冷やかしだなんてガキみたいな
　事はしませんから。ともかく、おめでとうご
　ざいます」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry, I'm not the type to gossip about childish
things like that. In any case, congratulations."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry, I'm not the type to gossip about childish
things like that. In any case, congratulations."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ありがと……でもそんなこと言って、今だっ
　て冷やかしに来たんじゃないの？」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you... but you came here for that sole purpose,
didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"Thank you... but you came here for that sole purpose,
didn't you?"

dialogues.jp: 冷たい視線で、ぴしゃんと｛にら／睨｝んでくる。
dialogues.en: A cold expression, and a stern gaze gave me the shivers.
dialogues.text: A cold expression, and a stern gaze gave me the shivers.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……ま、いいや。それじゃ、改めて紹介しよ
　うかな。こちら、｛さえき／佐伯｝さん」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, it's okay. Anyway, I should introduce you. This is
Saeki."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, it's okay. Anyway, I should introduce you. This is
Saeki."

dialogues.jp:
互いに名前を名乗って、俺達はぺこぺこやりあっ
た。
dialogues.en:
As we both explained how to write the kanji from our names,
we politely bowed to each other.
dialogues.text:
As we both explained how to write the kanji from our names,
we politely bowed to each other.

dialogues.jp: 「で、いい物件とか見つかりました？」
dialogues.en: "So, have you found anything good?"
dialogues.text: "So, have you found anything good?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉に、ふたりは顔を見合わせると、軽く
肩をすくめた。
dialogues.en:
In response, they looked at each other, then turned back to
me and shrugged their shoulders.
dialogues.text:
In response, they looked at each other, then turned back to
me and shrugged their shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Male
dialogues.jp:
「さして広くもない島の中だからね。あまり、
　選り好みも出来ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"There isn't much available within this island, so we can't
afford to be picky."
dialogues.text:
"There isn't much available within this island, so we can't
afford to be picky."

dialogues.speaker: Male
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、初音島の中なんですか」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, you wish to stay on Hatsunejima."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, you wish to stay on Hatsunejima."

dialogues.jp:
って、商店街の不動産屋を見てるんだから、そ
れも当たり前か。
dialogues.en:
Although, considering they're looking at real estate
advertisements in the shopping district, of course they
would be.
dialogues.text:
Although, considering they're looking at real estate
advertisements in the shopping district, of course they
would be.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「島を離れるのは、ちょっとね……なるべく、
　妹のそばに居たいし……」
dialogues.en:
"Leaving the island is a bit... well, I'd rather stay by my
sister's side..."
dialogues.text:
"Leaving the island is a bit... well, I'd rather stay by my
sister's side..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「結婚しても、気軽に会いに行きたいしね……
　その点、朝倉は大変だねえ」
dialogues.en:
"Even after marriage, still visting each other often...
that's where your case is sad."
dialogues.text:
"Even after marriage, still visting each other often...
that's where your case is sad."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、親ですか？　ま、あんまり気にしたこ
　とはないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, you mean my parents? Please don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "Ah, you mean my parents? Please don't worry about it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや、朝倉音夢の方だよ」
dialogues.en: "No, I meant Asakura Nemu."
dialogues.text: "No, I meant Asakura Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「…………？　音夢も、別に気にしているよう
　には見えませんけど……」
dialogues.en:
"......? I don't think Nemu's particularly bothered by it
either..."
dialogues.text:
"......? I don't think Nemu's particularly bothered by it
either..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃなくて。朝倉音夢も引っ越すんだろ
　う。そっちのこと」
dialogues.en: "No no no, I mean about Nemu's moving out."
dialogues.text: "No no no, I mean about Nemu's moving out."

dialogues.jp:
耳にしてから、意味を理解するまで、ほんの少
しのタイムラグがあった。
dialogues.en:
There was a time lag between what I heard, and my brain
comprehending it.
dialogues.text:
There was a time lag between what I heard, and my brain
comprehending it.

dialogues.jp: ──空耳？　理解した意味が、納得出来ない。
dialogues.en: --A mishearing? I couldn't assent to what my ears had heard.
dialogues.text: --A mishearing? I couldn't assent to what my ears had heard.

dialogues.jp: 「……あの、今、何て言いました？」
dialogues.en: "...Uhm, do you mind repeating what you just said?"
dialogues.text: "...Uhm, do you mind repeating what you just said?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　だから、引っ越し。朝倉音夢は、島を
　出るんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm? About her moving? Asakura Nemu's leaving the island,
isn't she?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm? About her moving? Asakura Nemu's leaving the island,
isn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「何でも看護師を目指すとかで、本校には進学
　しないって言ってきたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"She was saying that she wanted to be a nurse, and the main
school couldn't fufill that dream for her."
dialogues.text:
"She was saying that she wanted to be a nurse, and the main
school couldn't fufill that dream for her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだ？　変な顔して……まさか、聞
　いてなかったのか？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong? Your face looks bad... don't tell me this is
the first you've heard of it?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong? Your face looks bad... don't tell me this is
the first you've heard of it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、俺、失礼します。さよならっ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, please excuse me. Goodbye!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, please excuse me. Goodbye!"

dialogues.jp:
くるりと視界が回転する。不思議そうに顔を見
合わせる二人が、視界から消え去った。
dialogues.en:
I rotated my view 180 degrees, their confused faces
disappearing from my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I rotated my view 180 degrees, their confused faces
disappearing from my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、家へと向かって走っていた。
dialogues.en: I started running back home.
dialogues.text: I started running back home.

dialogues.en: "Nemu..."
dialogues.text: "Nemu..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……どうしたんです？　そんな、息を切らせ
　たりして」
dialogues.en: "...What's up? You look out of breath."
dialogues.text: "...What's up? You look out of breath."

dialogues.jp:
テレビのドラマに見入っていた音夢が、不思議
そうな顔で見上げてきた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, watching a drama serial on the TV, looked up at me
with a curious face.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, watching a drama serial on the TV, looked up at me
with a curious face.

dialogues.jp:
何度か呼吸して息を整え、俺はリモコンを手に
取った。
dialogues.en:
I steadied myself and caught my breath, then grabbed the
remote control.
dialogues.text:
I steadied myself and caught my breath, then grabbed the
remote control.

dialogues.jp: ――ピッ
dialogues.en: --*pishu*
dialogues.text: --*pishu*

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ……ちょっと、兄さん、どうして消しちゃ
　うんです？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... wait a minute. Why did you switch it off?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... wait a minute. Why did you switch it off?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「真面目な話なんだ」
dialogues.en: "I have something serious to say."
dialogues.text: "I have something serious to say."

dialogues.jp:
リモコンをテーブルに置き、しっかりと音夢を
見据えた。
dialogues.en:
I placed the remote control back onto the table, and
returned my gaze to Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I placed the remote control back onto the table, and
returned my gaze to Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「……島、出るんだって？」
dialogues.en: "...Are you leaving the island?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you leaving the island?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱり、本当なんだな……」
dialogues.en: "...So it really is true..."
dialogues.text: "...So it really is true..."

dialogues.jp:
言葉よりも何よりも雄弁な態度に、俺はがっく
りと肩を落とした。
dialogues.en:
My shoulders drooped instantly and I collapsed into a nearby
chair.
dialogues.text:
My shoulders drooped instantly and I collapsed into a nearby
chair.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは……その……」
dialogues.en: "That.. is..."
dialogues.text: "That.. is..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうして外なんだ？　詩人か小説家なら、別
　にここでも出来るだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Why leave? You're not planning on becoming a poet or a
novelist, are you?"
dialogues.text:
"Why leave? You're not planning on becoming a poet or a
novelist, are you?"

dialogues.jp:
確か前に、そんな職業に就きたい──なんて笑
いながら口にしていた覚えがある。
dialogues.en: I inadvertently made a joke, but I was in no mood to laugh.
dialogues.text: I inadvertently made a joke, but I was in no mood to laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……看護師に……なりたいの……」
dialogues.en: "...I want to... become a nurse..."
dialogues.text: "...I want to... become a nurse..."

dialogues.jp: うつむいて、ぽそりと呟く。
dialogues.en: She hung her head ruefully while whispering.
dialogues.text: She hung her head ruefully while whispering.

dialogues.jp: 「看護師？」
dialogues.en: "A nurse?"
dialogues.text: "A nurse?"

dialogues.jp:
「なんで、いきなり看護師なんだ？　そんなこ
　と１度も言ってなかっただろ」
dialogues.en:
"When did this happen? This is the first time you've told me
about this..."
dialogues.text:
"When did this happen? This is the first time you've told me
about this..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「体調が悪くなったときに、看護師さんにお世
　話になって、私も病気で困っている人の力に
　なりたいなって思って……」
dialogues.en:
"When I was always sick, nurses would always look after me
and do their best to help me get well... I wanted to repay
the favour..."
dialogues.text:
"When I was always sick, nurses would always look after me
and do their best to help me get well... I wanted to repay
the favour..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……それならそれで、ちゃんと話せって
　の」
dialogues.en:
"Haa... if that's all it was, you should've just told me
straight up..."
dialogues.text:
"Haa... if that's all it was, you should've just told me
straight up..."

dialogues.jp:
いきなり島の外に出るなんて聞いたら、ビック
リするだろうが……まったく。
dialogues.en:
It was a huge shock to just hear so abruptly that she was
leaving the island... geez.
dialogues.text:
It was a huge shock to just hear so abruptly that she was
leaving the island... geez.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……なかなか言い出せなくて
　……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm really sorry... I wanted to tell you, but it was hard
to..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm really sorry... I wanted to tell you, but it was hard
to..."

dialogues.jp: しゅんとしているさまが、まだまだ子供だ。
dialogues.en: Still a kid in the end.
dialogues.text: Still a kid in the end.

dialogues.jp: 「で、家から通えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Will you commute from here?"
dialogues.text: "Will you commute from here?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……寮に入る……」
dialogues.en: "No... I'd live in the dormitories..."
dialogues.text: "No... I'd live in the dormitories..."

dialogues.jp: それで、余計に言い出せなかったんだな。
dialogues.en: I couldn't think of anything to argue against that.
dialogues.text: I couldn't think of anything to argue against that.

dialogues.jp: 「手続きとかはもう済んでるのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Have you finished all the neccessary procedures and
paperwork already?"
dialogues.text:
"Have you finished all the neccessary procedures and
paperwork already?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……うん。ごめんね、勝手に」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah. I'm sorry for being so selfish."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah. I'm sorry for being so selfish."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「謝るなっての。バカ」
dialogues.en: "Don't apologize, stupid."
dialogues.text: "Don't apologize, stupid."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……バカって、何よぅ」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean, stupid..."
dialogues.text: "What do you mean, stupid..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺が反対するとでも思ったのかよ？」
dialogues.en: "Did you think I'd be opposed to it?"
dialogues.text: "Did you think I'd be opposed to it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって……」
dialogues.en: "But that's..."
dialogues.text: "But that's..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がしょんぼりと目を伏せる。
dialogues.en: Nemu's eyes fell to the floor.
dialogues.text: Nemu's eyes fell to the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、一人になっちゃうんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, you'd be alone here, right?"
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, you'd be alone here, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「心配すんな」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about that."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「掃除だって、洗濯だって、自分でやらないと
　ダメなんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Can you really do the laundry and cleaning by yourself?"
dialogues.text: "Can you really do the laundry and cleaning by yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、分かってる」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I understand how to."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I understand how to."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「朝も、起こしてくれる人がいないんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"You won't have anyone to wake you up in the morning
anymore, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"You won't have anyone to wake you up in the morning
anymore, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「目覚ましがあるからな。平気だ」
dialogues.en: "I have an alarm clock now, it'd be fine."
dialogues.text: "I have an alarm clock now, it'd be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それにご飯だって、私が居なくなったら……」
dialogues.en: "And I won't be here to cook meals for you anymore..."
dialogues.text: "And I won't be here to cook meals for you anymore..."

dialogues.jp:
どさくさに紛れて、妙な事を言われたような気
がする。
dialogues.en: In the confusion, I managed to catch that.
dialogues.text: In the confusion, I managed to catch that.

dialogues.jp:
「少なくとも食生活だけは、お前が居なくなっ
　ても、なぁ〜〜〜んも変わらんぞ」
dialogues.en:
"My eating habits won't change one single bit, whether
you're here or not."
dialogues.text:
"My eating habits won't change one single bit, whether
you're here or not."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん、強調しすぎ」
dialogues.en: "...That was a bit too much emphasis, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "...That was a bit too much emphasis, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「見事な呼吸法だろう」
dialogues.en: "Your powers of observation are astounding."
dialogues.text: "Your powers of observation are astounding."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...*giggle*"
dialogues.text: "...*giggle*"

dialogues.jp: 目尻に指を当てながら、音夢が言った。
dialogues.en:
Nemu rubbed the corner of her eye with her finger, and
continues talking.
dialogues.text:
Nemu rubbed the corner of her eye with her finger, and
continues talking.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もうちょっとしんみりするかなって思ったけ
　ど……そうでもなかったね」
dialogues.en:
"I thought the conversation would be a bit more serious than
this..."
dialogues.text:
"I thought the conversation would be a bit more serious than
this..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「何でそんな必要があるよ？　今生の別れって
　わけでもあるまいし」
dialogues.en:
"That's not really needed, is it? It's not like you're
disappearing from my life."
dialogues.text:
"That's not really needed, is it? It's not like you're
disappearing from my life."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん……そうだよね、ほんとに、そう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... that's right. That's really true."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... that's right. That's really true."

dialogues.jp:
深い吐息のように、音夢が呟く。そして、反動
をつけて、ソファーから立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu gave a deep sigh after muttering those words. She then
stood up from the sofa.
dialogues.text:
Nemu gave a deep sigh after muttering those words. She then
stood up from the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お別れの記念に、何か、シャンパンでも買っ
　てくるね」
dialogues.en:
"I feel like buying some champagne to commerorate this
event."
dialogues.text:
"I feel like buying some champagne to commerorate this
event."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「シャンパンって……酒なんて飲めないだろ」
dialogues.en: "Champagne...? I don't even drink sake..."
dialogues.text: "Champagne...? I don't even drink sake..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫です。ちゃんと、ノンアルコールのも
　の買ってくるから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. I'd buy a non-alcoholic version for you."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. I'd buy a non-alcoholic version for you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、ならいいけど」
dialogues.en: "...I guess that would be fine."
dialogues.text: "...I guess that would be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……うん。それじゃ、ちょっと行ってくるね。
　兄さん」
dialogues.en: "...Okay. Then I'd go now, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "...Okay. Then I'd go now, nii-san."

dialogues.jp: ぱたぱたと小さく手を振る。
dialogues.en: She waved her hand slightly in goodbye.
dialogues.text: She waved her hand slightly in goodbye.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ。行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, be careful."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, be careful."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ようやく溜め込んでいた空気が抜けた。
dialogues.en: All the air I had kept in finally expelled itself out.
dialogues.text: All the air I had kept in finally expelled itself out.

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく」
dialogues.en: "...grrr."
dialogues.text: "...grrr."

dialogues.jp: 「音夢ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu!!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　に、兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? B, brother?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? B, brother?"

dialogues.jp: 必要以上に目をしばたいて、音夢が振り返った。
dialogues.en:
With far more confused eyes than I thought was neccessary,
Nemu turned around.
dialogues.text:
With far more confused eyes than I thought was neccessary,
Nemu turned around.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、一緒に行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's go together."
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's go together."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、で、でも……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, b, but..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, b, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でもじゃないっての。だいたい、今日は俺が
　買い物に行く日だろ」
dialogues.en:
"No buts. In any case, today's supposed to be my day to buy
dinner."
dialogues.text:
"No buts. In any case, today's supposed to be my day to buy
dinner."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね。一緒に行こうか」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Let's go together."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Let's go together."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.jp:
街灯の光が弱々しく辺りを照らす中、俺達は商
店街へと歩いていった。
dialogues.en:
With the dim lights of the streetlamps shining onto us, we
walked slowly towards the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
With the dim lights of the streetlamps shining onto us, we
walked slowly towards the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
言葉は少なくとも、心の中に、温かで、そして
寂しいものが満ちてくる。
dialogues.en:
We didn't exchange words, but in my heart, a warm and lonely
feeling was flowing.
dialogues.text:
We didn't exchange words, but in my heart, a warm and lonely
feeling was flowing.

dialogues.jp: それは音夢も、同じなのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Is Nemu feeling the same way too?
dialogues.text: Is Nemu feeling the same way too?

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、血は繋がっていないけれど、紛れもな
い兄妹だから。
dialogues.en:
We aren't related by blood, but somehow we became siblings
anyway.
dialogues.text:
We aren't related by blood, but somehow we became siblings
anyway.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、たった一人の、俺の妹なのだから……。
dialogues.en: And in the end, she'd always be my little sister...
dialogues.text: And in the end, she'd always be my little sister...

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢が島を出る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu's Leaving the Island◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu's Leaving the Island◆

dialogues.jp:
夕飯を買いに行った帰り、一人の男性と一緒の
暦先生を見かけた。先生の婚約者だそうだ。
dialogues.en:
On the way home from buying dinner, I ran into Koyomi-sensei
with a man. It was sensei's fiance.
dialogues.text:
On the way home from buying dinner, I ran into Koyomi-sensei
with a man. It was sensei's fiance.

dialogues.jp:
雑談を交わしている中で、何と、音夢が島を離
れるらしいという事を聞いた。急いで家へと戻
る俺。
dialogues.en:
Through some idle conversation, I learnt for the first time
that Nemu was leaving the island. I rushed back home once I
heard that.
dialogues.text:
Through some idle conversation, I learnt for the first time
that Nemu was leaving the island. I rushed back home once I
heard that.

dialogues.jp:
音夢に確かめると、果たして、その話は本当だっ
た。何でも、看護師になるためだそうだ。島を
出て、寮生活を始めるのだという。
dialogues.en:
I confirmed with Nemu, and as expected, what I learnt was
true. She was leaving the island in order to become a nurse.
She'd leave the island and start her life as a boarding
student.
dialogues.text:
I confirmed with Nemu, and as expected, what I learnt was
true. She was leaving the island in order to become a nurse.
She'd leave the island and start her life as a boarding
student.

dialogues.jp:
全く、前もって言ってくれよな。びっくりする
だろうが……。
dialogues.en:
Really, she should've told me earlier. She really scared
me...
dialogues.text:
Really, she should've told me earlier. She really scared
me...
